disclosures.text: A crane with a trolley
A base transceiver on the trolley
Base transceiver radiates a base transmit signal
Base transceiver receives a first transponder signal
Base transceiver receives a second transponder signal
A first transponder at a predetermined location relative to the crane
First transponder receives the base transmit signal
First transponder radiates the first transponder signal upon receiving the base transmit signal
A second transponder on a load, hook, or target
Second transponder receives the base transmit signal
Second transponder radiates the second transponder signal upon receiving the base transmit signal
Second transponder signal is different from the first transponder signal
An evaluation device coupled to the base transceiver
Evaluation device determines distance of first transponder from trolley based on first transponder signal and base transmit signal
Evaluation device determines distance of second transponder from trolley based on second transponder signal and base transmit signal

A crane with a trolley, a base transceiver on the trolley radiating a base transmit signal and receiving first and second transponder signals, a first transponder at a predetermined location receiving the base signal and radiating the first
First transponder is attached to a boom of the crane
First transponder is attached to the boom less than 0.5m from where the boom attaches to the mast
Second transponder is on the hook
A third transponder is at a predefined location spaced from the first transponder location
Position of the second predefined location is independent of boom movement
Third transponder is attached to the load's target destination
A fourth transponder is spaced from the first transponder on the crane boom
Base transceiver receives a fourth transponder signal from the fourth transponder
Evaluation device determines trolley distance from fourth transponder based on base transmit signal and fourth transponder signal
Evaluation device checks functionality by comparing distances of first and fourth transponders from the trolley
Fourth transponder is less than 0.5m from the boom tip
Evaluation device determines first transponder distance from trolley based on transit time of base transmit signal to first transponder
Evaluation device determines second transponder distance from base transceiver based on transit time of base transmit signal to second transponder
Crane is a luffing jib crane
A tilt sensor on the suspension cable or crane hook generates a tilt sensor signal
Tilt sensor signal depends on angle between suspension cable and boom
Evaluation device coupled to tilt sensor receives tilt sensor signal
Evaluation device determines load distance from trolley parallel to mast from second transponder signal and tilt sensor signal
Evaluation device determines load distance from trolley perpendicular to mast from second transponder signal and tilt sensor signal
Evaluation device determines vertical acceleration from tilt sensor signal and second transponder signal at three time points
Evaluation device determines horizontal acceleration from tilt sensor signal and second transponder signal at three time points
Evaluation device coupled to lifting device, trolley movement device, or mast rotation device
Evaluation device compares acceleration to a critical threshold
Evaluation device controls lifting device, trolley movement device, or mast rotation device if threshold is exceeded
Base transceiver radiates base transmit signal periodically
A receiver at the crane control station
Evaluation device and base transceiver are a single physical unit
Evaluation device radiates a radio signal with distance information of first and second transponders from trolley
Receiver receives radio signal and determines and displays transponder distances from trolley
Evaluation device determines trolley distance from mast
Evaluation device determines load moment from trolley distance from mast
Evaluation device compares load moment to a permissible load moment limit
Evaluation device coupled to trolley movement device
Evaluation device controls trolley movement to prevent exceeding permissible load moment
Transponder is attached to a boom of the crane
Transponder is attached to the boom less than 0.5m from where the boom attaches to the mast
An additional transponder is attached to the crane boom
Base transceiver receives an additional transponder signal from the additional transponder
Evaluation device determines transponder distance from trolley based on transponder signal
Evaluation device determines trolley distance from additional transponder based on base transmit signal and additional transponder signal
Evaluation device checks functionality by comparing distances of transponder and additional transponder from the trolley
Additional transponder is less than 0.5m from the boom tip
Evaluation device determines load moment from transit time of base transmit signal to transponder
Evaluation device determines load moment from transit time of transponder signal to base transceiver
Weighing device is spaced from the base transceiver
Weighing device radiates a weighing radio signal dependent on load weight
Base transceiver receives weighing radio signal and determines load weight
Base transceiver and evaluation device are a single physical unit
Evaluation device radiates a radio signal dependent on load moment value
Receiver receives radio signal and determines and displays load moment value
